name: Smoke Reset VR
summary:
SmokeReset is a calm, guided wellness experience designed to support you while
you quit smoking.

Put the headset on, sit back, and let the session do the work. Every session
combines soothing music with binaural tones, spoken affirmations, guided
breathing and slow, hypnotic visuals — a ritual you can keep, day after day,
without effort or willpower battles.


THE 4-WEEK PLAN

Your plan gives you two sessions a day for four weeks:
